tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand crimson. Status bar, filled buttons, selected states, the loader. White text on it in light (5.0:1); black on it in dark (7.0:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for selected nav items and the detail FAB.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary-container`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Same crimson as `primary` in this app (Color.kt sets both to #dd0d3c / #ea6d7e).

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondary`.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Selected-item pill behind the bottom navigation icon (Material 3 NavigationBar indicator).

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Icon and label on `secondary-container`.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Rose accent; available but unused by the app's own components.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on `tertiary`.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Tinted rose fill.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text on `tertiary-container`.

tokens.name: error

tokens.usage: Text on `error`.

tokens.name: error-container

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `error-container`.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background; also the market card fill in light theme.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Body text on `background`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Surface behind lists, the detail screen and dialogs.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface` and `surface-variant`; chart axis labels.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Market card fill in dark theme; muted fills.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text and unselected icons on `surface` and `surface-variant`.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Dividers (the line under "Market Data") and control borders.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis dividers.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar fill.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on `inverse-surface` (snackbars).

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Primary-coloured actions on `inverse-surface`.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Elevation tint Material 3 blends into raised surfaces.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal scrim, used at reduced opacity.

tokens.name: graph-line
tokens.usage: QuadLineChart price line (2px, round caps), both themes.

tokens.name: graph-fill
tokens.usage: Top stop of the chart's vertical fill gradient (`graph-line` at 50% alpha), fading to transparent.

tokens.name: trend-up
tokens.usage: Price-change arrow and percentage when the 24h change is positive. Always paired with the up arrow. Below 4.5:1 for text in both themes (about 2.7:1 on `background` light, 3.0:1 on `surface-variant` dark): kept exact from the source; flagged.

tokens.name: trend-down
tokens.usage: Price-change arrow and percentage when the 24h change is negative. Always paired with the down arrow. 4.7:1 on `background` light; about 2.4:1 on `surface-variant` dark: kept exact from the source; flagged.

tokens.name: favorite-on
tokens.usage: Filled heart when a market is a favorite (Compose Color.Red), both themes.

tokens.name: favorite-off
tokens.usage: Heart when not a favorite (Compose Color.LightGray), both themes.

tokens.name: card-container
tokens.usage: MarketItem card fill: `background` in light, `surface-variant` in dark.

tokens.name: swipe-delete
tokens.usage: Swipe-to-dismiss background once the swipe targets delete.

tokens.name: swipe-idle
tokens.usage: Swipe-to-dismiss background before the threshold (LightGray / Gray).

tokens.name: shimmer-base
tokens.usage: Outer stops of the loading shimmer gradient, both themes.

tokens.name: shimmer-highlight
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the loading shimmer gradient.

tokens.name: status-bar
tokens.usage: Status bar colour declared in res/values colors.xml (Theme.kt paints the bar `primary` at runtime).

tokens.name: logo-green

tokens.name: logo-navy

tokens.name: logo-ink

tokens.name: logo-blue
tokens.usage: Logo only: lower face.

tokens.usage: Logo only: inner lower face.
